verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا
verses.translation: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
verses.translation: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture[1811] that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
verses.footnotes: [1811]- i.e., a combination of the male and female substance, within the womb.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
verses.translation: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا
verses.translation: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kāfūr,[1812]

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
verses.translation: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allāh will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا
verses.translation: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
verses.translation: And they give food in spite of love for it[1813] to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
verses.footnotes: [1813]- The meaning here may also be "out of love for Him," i.e., Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā).

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
verses.translation: [Saying], "We feed you only for the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
verses.translation: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."

verses.arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
verses.translation: So Allāh will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness

verses.arabic: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
verses.translation: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].

verses.arabic: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
verses.translation: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
verses.translation: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.arabic: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
verses.translation: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.arabic: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
verses.translation: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.

verses.arabic: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
verses.translation: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural, passive

verses.arabic: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا
verses.translation: [From] a fountain within it [i.e., Paradise] named Salsabeel.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.arabic: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا
verses.translation: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
verses.translation: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.

verses.arabic: عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
verses.translation: Upon them [i.e., the inhabitants] will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, plural, passive

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
verses.translation: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا
verses.translation: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muḥammad], the Qur’ān progressively.

verses.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
verses.translation: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 2nd person, masculine, singular
Active participle — accusative, masculine, singular, indefinite

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
verses.translation: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
verses.translation: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt [i.e., praise] Him a long [part of the] night.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
verses.translation: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them[1814] a grave Day.
verses.footnotes: [1814]- i.e., neglect. The meaning may also be "leave ahead of them."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
verses.translation: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
verses.translation: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
verses.translation: And you do not will except that Allāh wills. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
verses.translation: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
